title: Tsai Ao

page_data.en:

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commandant. SMC

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 25
Date ... / ...
27th January 1916

Sir,
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels received
$20,000.00 on 26th instant from General Tsai Ao 蔡□ who
has requested them to raise the standard of rebellion
before the Chinese New Year. The Shanghai rebels have
replied saying that they are unable to comply with the request.
The Arsenal Authorities have for some time been
negotiating with the country people with a view to purchasing
600 mow of land in the vicinity of the Arsenal. It is
now said that some of the farmers are unwilling to sell
their land at the price offered, and they intend to
riot if the Authorities try to force them to do so.

Your Obedient Servant,

William Hume Troup
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海公共租界工部局总监。

上海公共租界工部局。

刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 25 号
日期 ... / ...
1916年1月27日

先生：

据报，上海叛乱分子于本月26日从蔡锷将军处收到20,000.00美元，该将军要求他们在农历新年前举旗起事。上海叛乱分子回复称，他们无法遵从此项要求。

兵工厂当局一段时间以来一直与当地乡民协商，旨在购买兵工厂附近600亩土地。现闻部分农民不愿以所出价格出售其土地，并声称若当局强迫他们出售，他们将发动暴动。

您顺从的仆人，

威廉·休姆·特鲁普 (William Hume Troup)
首席侦探督察

警察总监
